description: Trivial majority-class baseline that predicts Supported (S) for every claim.
Uniform random coin-flip baseline predicting S or NS with equal probability.
Porter stemming, stopword removal, and max-over-passages unigram recall with threshold tau=0.65.
DeBERTa-v3 cross-encoder with lexical overlap pruning (th_high=0.85, th_mod=0.65, tau_nli=0.005).
